price_source: UNVERIFIED — entered from memory on 2026-09-15. openrouter.ai is denied by the build environment's network policy (CONNECT 403) and no OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY was present. Run `python run_perfect_lie.py --refresh-prices` from a machine with OpenRouter access before Phase 2; it overwrites usd_per_1k_* from GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, checks every id exists, and records the fetch date.

reasoning_design.note: Reasoning budget is a within-weights factor: each family's levels use one model id and differ only in OpenRouter's unified `reasoning` request field. Tier 1 = level `off` for every family (the primary preregistered test). Tier 2 = every other level. Thinking tokens are billed as output; expected_thinking_tokens is a cost assumption replaced by pilot measurement. max_output_tokens is sent as max_tokens and must exceed thinking budget + story.

liar_models.true_off_note: gpt-5 has no non-thinking mode on the same weights; `off` is effort=minimal. Preregistered as a partial replication of the off level.

liar_models.levels_note: Hybrid thinking model with an on/off switch but no budget control, so it has two levels. `high` is used for the on state so that it aligns with the other families' upper level; there is no `low`.

target_model.note: One fixed non-thinking target for every cell so target gullibility does not vary with liar family or budget. Tertiary measure only.

graders.note: Preregistered cue grader. Non-thinking, temperature 0. Blind by construction (grader.py). Shares a family with one liar; the secondary grader is the robustness check.
Same rubric, same 2,640 lies. Reported as inter-grader agreement and as a re-analysis of T; never pooled with the primary.

trace_probe.note: Secondary process measure on thinking-tier lies whose provider returns a trace: does the trace refer to the audience's beliefs? Separate blind pass; the trace never enters the cue grader (invariant 5).

open: meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct (no thinking mode; single level only)
openai_true_off: openai/gpt-4.1 as a non-thinking sibling; rejected because different post-training breaks the within-weights factor
google: google/gemini-2.5-pro (min thinking budget 128; no true off)

token_assumptions.note: Per-call token estimates used by --dry-run. Liar user prompt is the measured FibberPrompt render; system prompt is measured per condition; the rest are conservative round numbers. Phase 2 pilot replaces them with measured means.
